title: New BlackX UEFI bootkit exploiting Baton Drop
content: In early 2026, a sophisticated APT campaign targeting diplomatic agencies in Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan deployed BlackX, a UEFI bootkit similar to the notorious BlackLotus. The bootkit exploits the Baton Drop vulnerability (CVE-2022-21894) to bypass Secure Boot and install malicious drivers into the Windows kernel. title: LiteLLM PyPI Package and Docker Images Compromised to Steal Cloud and AI Credentials
content: LiteLLM version 1.107.0 was compromised through a supply chain attack affecting both PyPI packages and Docker images. The malicious release contains Python startup files that automatically execute upon Python initialization, stealing cloud credentials, private keys, browser data, and AI development tool authentication.
